test_title: PYST 70: SSC CPO - General Knowledge and General Awareness (Held On 10 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: gk
question: SHC scheme is implemented by which ministry?

options.text: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC)
Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare (MoA & FW)
Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI)

solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare (MoA & FW)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Soil Health Card (SHC) scheme was launched by the **Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare** to promote soil testing and balanced use of fertilizers.
 
• The **SHC scheme** was launched by the Government of India in **February 2015** to address the issue of soil degradation and improve the overall productivity of agricultural land.
 
• The scheme aims to provide farmers with a **soil health card** that contains information about the nutrient status of their soil and recommendations for appropriate fertilizer application.
 
• The implementation of the SHC scheme involves **soil sample collection, testing, and issuing cards to farmers**, enabling them to make informed decisions for crop production.
 
• The Soil Health Card scheme has been implemented across all states and union territories of India, covering millions of farmers and agricultural holdings.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Objectives of the SHC Scheme:**

 
 
• To assess the soil quality and nutrient composition for better agricultural practices.
 
• To promote the balanced use of fertilizers and reduce the excessive application of chemical fertilizers.
 
• To improve the **long-term soil health** and enhance agricultural productivity sustainably.
 
 
 
• **Process of Soil Health Card Generation:**
 
 
• Soil samples are collected from the farmer's field based on a **grid of 2.5 hectares for irrigated areas** and **10 hectares for rainfed areas**.
 
• The samples are tested in **soil testing laboratories** to determine the nutrient composition.
 
• A Soil Health Card is generated, providing farmers with crop-specific recommendations on **nutrient management**.
 
 
 
• **Functions of the SHC Scheme:**
 
 
• Guiding farmers on using fertilizers based on soil type and nutrient deficiency.
 
• Encouraging farmers to adopt organic farming and integrated nutrient management practices.
 
• Creating awareness about soil health and **educating farmers** on sustainable agricultural practices.
 
 
 
• **Achievements of the SHC Scheme:**
 
 
• As of **2023**, millions of soil health cards have been distributed to farmers across India.
 
• Studies have shown that the use of SHC has led to better fertilizer application practices and increased productivity in certain crops.
 
• The scheme has contributed significantly to promoting sustainable farming practices and reducing environmental degradation.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare:**

 
 
• The ministry is responsible for the development and implementation of policies related to agriculture, farmers' welfare, and rural development.
 
• It oversees schemes such as the **Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)**, **National Food Security Mission (NFSM)**, and **Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY)**.
 
 
 
• **Other Ministries Mentioned:**
 
 
• **Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC):** Focuses on environmental protection, biodiversity conservation, and climate change mitigation.
 
• **Ministry of Jal Shakti:** Works on water resource management and the implementation of schemes like **Har Ghar Jal** and **Namami Gange**.
 
• **Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI):** Responsible for statistical data collection and monitoring of government programs.
